lines.1: 「I can't believe only Subaru and I brought umbrellas.」
lines.2: 「What? I was gonna swipe something from the umbrella rack, but you stopped me.」
lines.4: 「Hey, quit shoving. You're getting me wet.」
lines.5: That damn Crab kept pressing herself against me.
lines.6: 「This umbrella isn't very big. If I hold back, I'll get wet.」
lines.8: 「Oh, I know! I'll try riding on your back. Then we won't be as wide, so there'll be less of us for the rain to hit.」
lines.9: 「You just don't want to walk. Hey--whoa!」
lines.10: She suddenly jumped onto my back.
lines.11: 「Damn, no good. Now we're too tall, and my bag's getting wet.」
lines.12: She hopped back down to the ground.
lines.15: 「What? I'm trying to find a way for both of us to stay dry! If you'd do what Subaru's doing up ahead, we could skip all this trouble!」
lines.17: Fukahire was under Subaru's clear plastic umbrella.
lines.19: But Subaru was holding the umbrella so Fukahire stayed dry, and the entire right half of his own body was pretty soaked.
lines.20: He'd let himself get soaked to keep a friend completely covered. That was Subaru.
lines.21: That was why I never understood why everyone found him so frightening.
lines.24: Meanwhile, I had my hands full dealing with a thoroughly energetic Crab.
lines.25: 「Oh, come to think of it, don't you want revenge on the disciplinary committee?」
lines.26: 「I can't beat her fair and square, so I'm gonna attack her mind. You know, psychological weak points and stuff.」
lines.28: 「So, found any weaknesses in Kurogane yet?」
lines.29: 「Nothing but stories about her martial exploits and how brave she is. She's good at school, too, and the third-years respect her and fear her. They even call her Big Sis.」
lines.31: 「N-Now, now, everyone has a weakness. Once I find hers, I'll keep picking at it until she cracks.」
lines.32: A truly rotten person always has something special to say.
lines.36: Time to spend the afternoon productively watching reruns of some TV drama.
lines.37: I was getting a little hungry, but once evening came, Subaru would show up with groceries.
